contracts.purpose: Links an operational work item to exactly one existing Scrum story without creating a second plan.
invariants: story_id resolves to the central Scrum plan; source_ref preserves the exact authoritative location.
A work item does not replace its story, acceptance criteria, approval gates or historical baseline.

contracts.purpose: Carries a traceable proposed change and its decision boundary to the owning authority.
invariants: A proposed change is not an approval; required user decisions retain their existing gate.
The owning module is updated only after conflict, impact and approval checks; no silent overwrite.

contracts.purpose: Transfers a visible claim and write scope for one executable work item.
invariants: One active claim per work item; ownership changes are explicit and traceable.
Overlapping critical write scopes require coordination; a worker cannot mark its own implementation Done without review and integration.

contracts.purpose: Carries the existing CMS content and publication state to the separate release approval gate, without granting publication approval.
invariants: A review result, local build or contract validation is not publication or release approval.
Publishing remains subject to the explicit approval for its concrete release scope and applicable content, image and privacy gates.

contracts.purpose: Maps existing published content identity into permitted analytics context.
invariants: content_id comes from the existing content or CMS structure and remains stable across URL changes; no parallel ID store.
Only the centrally defined event names, properties and tracking policy in docs/analytics.md govern actual analytics emission.
